data.narrative:
Axiom Space is a Series G-stage space systems company founded by Michael T. Suffredini and Kam Ghaffarian, having raised $350M to date. The private space sector includes 8 peer companies (SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, Planet Labs among them) and 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) spanning commercial launch, imaging, and orbital infrastructure.

Given data constraints, only stage-progression analysis proved applicable. Using total raised ($350M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.25x multiplier typical for Series G advancement yields $219M. The peer-median method could not be applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum density thresholds (0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage available). Public-comp anchoring was not viable—while the Space & Aerospace sector trades at a 24.6x median P/S across 6 public tickers, Axiom's revenue is not disclosed, precluding revenue-multiple application.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $186M to $252M, with $219M as the median point. This reflects a modest expansion on the capital deployed. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrowly comparable private transactions, undisclosed revenue metrics, and limited applicability of public multiples to an early-stage commercial space operator. Any revised analysis would benefit from revenue traction, customer contracts, or additional private market data points in orbital infrastructure.
